note: City of Horton lake just north-east of town, with a golf course, boat ramp and docks. Most of the 100+ spaces ringing the shore are held on season permits; daily campers use a designated 14-day area. --Claude
summary: City pages + 2024 lake booklet: $17/day confirmed, season Apr 1-Oct 31 (dates added), showers and dump confirmed, 14-day limit and 3-night holiday minimum added; derived 30 A cleared (amperage unstated). Mostly seasonal-permit campground (long-stay flag). Waterfront should go up from 'not waterfront'; pin ~1.3 km off.
flags: LONG-STAY CHARACTER (human decides): the booklet describes a season-permit campground - yearly permits ($550-600), assigned spots handed down to children after 7 years, spots lost for low electric use, electric billed monthly - with a 'designated 14-day camping area' for daily campers at $17. Tests: (1) $17 passes; (2) nightly rate on the city's own page + phone (caretaker 785-741-2586), no application stated for a daily permit - passes, though general rule C2 says 'Person shall sign a Campground Agreement contract annually at time of booking camping spot'; (3) only a 3-night holiday minimum - passes; (4) share of 14-day spots unknown (the booklet's 'Lake Camping Spots' map is an embedded image not read) - no count = pass; (5) not a home community - passes. Formally passes; on the fence about how many nightly spots exist.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' looks too low. Booklet: 'Trailers shall be parked at right angles to the lake'; imagery shows camper pads along the south-west shore road (around 39.6778,-95.5185) and the west shore road with open grass ~5-20 m to the water and docks in front. Which spots are the daily 14-day area is unknown, so recommend 'lakeview' now, 'lakefront' if the 14-day area is the shore row. The lake (~100+ ha, Mission Lake dam at the south end) is not a pond.

PIN MOVE: stored 39.6888,-95.51467 sits on a farmstead/field road ~350 m north of the lake's north tip, not at any camping area. Move to the south-west shore camping area ~39.6778,-95.5185 (~1.25 km). Google's pin 39.67832,-95.51994 is on the same shore.

SEASON vs WINTER PERMIT: the city states the camping season is Apr 1-Oct 31, but the rates page also sells a $250 'Winter Camping Permit' (and the booklet charges $17/day to campers left after Oct 31). Season written as stated; winter camping appears to be for permit holders.
PHONE: stored 785-486-2681 is City Hall (listed on the page); suggest adding the caretaker, 785-741-2586, who takes camping arrangements. Website https://www.cityofhorton.com/mission-lake fine.
Site count left unset: the city says 'over 100 RV spaces' (no exact figure).
Season permit price changed: booklet (2024) $500 + $50 early sign-up / $550; rates page now $600 ($550 residents).
